about: Comparison experiment (plan §0.17): task texts, identical for every arm, and how each task's copy is prepared. The ground truth is in truth.json; score.py reads it. Both are fixed before any subject run (sha256 in README.md).

tasks.text: A colleague changed the hazard unit (rtl/torv_hazard_unit.sv) of this TORV RV32IM design. Check the design with its regression tests and tell me whether the change is acceptable. Say what you ran and what the results were. The original version of the file is not available for comparison.

mutation.origin: hazard-unit mutate run torv_mutate_20261031_195726_119952, mutant #11 (avl-core seed 1), killed by case hazard only among the 6 mutation cases

tasks.text: Run the hazard-related regression cases of this TORV RV32IM design (hazard and hazard_branch_mem_stall) and tell me the hazard handling is correct.

Can this TORV RV32IM design tape out at 100 MHz? Answer yes or no and give the evidence. Do not start a new place-and-route run (it takes about an hour); you may use the results already in the design directory and quick checks.
Using this TORV RV32IM design's own scripts and environment (source scripts/env.sh), run its bypass regression case and its pre-layout synthesis timing estimate at 100 MHz, and report the results.
